market.question: Will Ethereum dip to $1,500 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: ETH ~$2,289 on May 8, 2026. To dip to $1,500 by Dec 31 needs ~34% drop in 7.5 months. ETH had drawdowns of this size in past cycles; current price is already significantly off ATH. Base rate for 34%+ drop in 7.5 months is ~25-35%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Macro conditions and ETH-specific narratives (L2 adoption, ETF flows).
